## A little more about me

I earned my Honours B.Sc. in Mathematics & Statistics, with a minor in Economics, at McMaster University. That training shaped the way I approach a question: examine the assumptions, organize the evidence, and explain what the analysis can support.

At Boston University, I'm building on that foundation through coursework in financial analytics, quantitative methods for finance, generative AI, and big data and cloud analytics. My academic projects span corporate filings, employer branding, financial statements, and population modeling.

My career goal is to contribute to financial or business analytics work where careful analysis and clear communication matter. I'm particularly interested in applying AI to financial information while keeping results traceable to their sources.

## Beyond coursework

As a volunteer online English teacher, I adapted lessons for children ages 6–13. I also welcomed incoming international students at Toronto Pearson Airport through McMaster University. These experiences strengthened my interest in making information accessible to people with different backgrounds.
